product.description: The Bosgame M2 is a compact mini PC powered by the AMD Ryzen 9 7940HS (8 cores / 16 threads, 4.00GHz up to 5.20GHz) with integrated AMD Ryzen AI rated up to 10 TOPS. It comes with 24GB DDR5-5600 memory and a 1TB NVMe SSD, plus an extra NVMe slot for more storage. Graphics come from the integrated AMD Radeon 780M. Connectivity includes Wi-Fi 6E, Bluetooth 5.3, two 2.5 Gigabit Ethernet ports, HDMI, DisplayPort and two Thunderbolt 4 Type-C ports, with built-in speakers.

faqs.question: Can I add more storage?
faqs.answer: Yes. It ships with a 1TB NVMe SSD and has an extra NVMe SSD slot for a second drive.

faqs.question: What graphics does it use?
faqs.answer: It uses AMD Radeon 780M integrated graphics built into the Ryzen 9 7940HS processor.

faqs.question: What ports does it have?
faqs.answer: On the front: 3 × USB 3.0, 1 × Type-C Thunderbolt 4 and an audio jack. On the back: 2 × USB 3.0, 2 × 2.5 Gigabit Ethernet, 1 × HDMI, 1 × DisplayPort and 1 × Type-C Thunderbolt 4.

faqs.question: Does it have Wi-Fi and Bluetooth?
faqs.answer: Yes, it has Wi-Fi 6E and Bluetooth 5.3.
